summary: 플레이어끼리 접촉하면 공동 에너지가 감소한다. 닿자마자 감소하고 계속 닿으면 일정 간격으로 다시 감소하며, 떨어졌다 다시 닿으면 즉시 감소한다. 표시 잔량이 0에 도달하면 모든 Player에 QuakeDead를 한 번 보낸다.

evidence.initialization: 0x18172f2e0..0x18172f336: scale=QFP._1, damage=QFP._1, interval=QFP._1_50, energy/max/target=QFP._10. QFP .cctor 0x181780cc0 resolved statically.
evidence.parameters: ParseParameter 0x18172f491/4aa/4c3 loads slots 3/4/5 as seven FP raws, then backwards first-nonzero selection from count-2 at 0x18172f5c5..61c, 680..6d3, 72c..780. Only positive overrides are stored at 0x18172f64c/650/654, 703, 7a8. Slot 6 is seven int32s, deserializer 0x180970770 (byte subtract 0x21 at 0x18097085b), Find 0x181786950, visibility bit0 written at 0x18172f7dd..819.
evidence.ui: Slots 0/1 add UI_POSX=0 and UI_POSY=396 (0x18172f508..52b); slot 2 multiplies by UI_BASE_SCALE=9 when absolute raw>=4 (0x18172f540..575). Initial scale is 1 if not overridden. .cctor inline stores 0x18173042f/445/45b; resolver confirmed raws 589824, 0, 25952256.
evidence.contact: checkCloseContact 0x18172fbd0: both GetPlayerByPlayerIndex results must exist, state byte +3 must be 1 (QPlayerState.Default), actors and GetCollision must resolve. Collision.GetRect plus collision position forms world bounds. Four tests at 0x18172fe0a/3d/70/9f allow overlap or gap<=QFP._0_01. Helper 0x181730470..4e9; QFP .cctor 0x181780cc0 +0x18 raw=655.
evidence.cooldown: updateContactedInfos 0x18172f910 iterates i<j, i/j in 0..7 (0x18172f983, 0x18172fb88/97), flat slot i*8+j. Contact timer subtracts FP DeltaTime at 0x18172fa5b. Timer<=0 subtracts damage from target at 0x18172fa94, clamps target to zero at 0x18172fac2..ae9 and sets pair timer=interval at 0x18172faf1. Separation resets timer=0 at 0x18172fb83. No global cooldown or per-player cap.
evidence.displayEnergy: updateEnergy 0x181730160 skips equal values. Visibility bit0 off snaps energy to target at 0x1817301ed. Otherwise sign(target-energy) * max * QFP._5 * DeltaTime is added using signed FP multiply shifts at 0x181730242/271/279, then clamped at 0x181730288..299. QFP._5 raw=327680 from .cctor.
evidence.failure: 0x1817302e7 GetEventParam(43=QuakeDead); 0x1817302fe NotifyEvent(actorType 27=Player); 0x18173030f sets exhausted flag bit1; OnPost 0x18172f8b9 skips all further processing. This is energy depletion, not a full-energy success signal.
evidence.feedback: showHitMark 0x18172fee0 resolves both collisions and calls CollisionUtility.CalcCollidedCenterPosition 0x18177f9f0 at 0x181730069, then FrameEvents._TouchEnergy_ShowHitMark at 0x1817300a2. SE 11 at 0x181730110 only if target>0 (0x1817300ce). Every damage also requests shake with QFP._0_10 raw 6553 (0x18172fb4f/53).

realStageValues.source: installed-stage-decoded.local.json; population-rules selects each actual online variant before filtering actors. Both stages have exactly one TouchEnergy at all counts.

integration.order: Call afterStep exactly once in Post, after native player movement. beforeStep is inert. No solids are produced.
integration.requiredInput: ctx.players contains native index 0..7, nativeState (1=Default), and collisionRectRaw={left,right,top,bottom} in native WORLD 16.16 coordinates. null collision represents GetCollision returning null. Missing native bounds/state fail explicitly; no sprite-size approximation.
integration.events: Route broadcastActorType=27,eventType=43 through the native Player QuakeDead handler, including its state/immortality rules. This module emits the event rather than directly changing players or replacing it with ordinary Dead.
integration.visuals: displays supplies visibility, interpolated energy, max, target, UI position/scale. hitMarks carries the two native player indices for the host collision-center effect, sounds carries SE 11, cameraShakes carries strengthRaw 6553.

measured: 14 real stage/population selections compile with exact decoded FP and int tables.
Contact tolerance accepts raw 655 and rejects 656 on both axes.
Continuous contact damages on ticks 1 and 62; one second is 65536 raw and one 60Hz tick is 1092.
2-player visible energy reaches first target on tick 7 and emits one QuakeDead broadcast on tick 68; remains unchanged for 120 later ticks.
Separate pair timers, sparse player indices, separation reset, hidden snap, missing/nondefault player handling and JSON replay verified.
verification.correction: First test draft incorrectly expected interpolation over 13 ticks and failure on tick 75. max=4 and speed=max*5=20 means a damage of 2 clamps after seven ticks. Corrected expectations to ticks 7/68, with explicit raw residual checks; module behavior was unchanged.

unresolved: Runtime registration and integration intentionally not performed under task scope. The host must provide native bounds/state and route QuakeDead; these requirements cannot be fulfilled by guessing dimensions or a different death event.

Exact hit-mark pixel position and view animation are not reproduced locally. Pair indices are emitted for host CollisionUtility.CalcCollidedCenterPosition integration (0x18177f9f0), whose geometry helper was not ported in this task.
Nonrepresentable authored float slots 0/1/2 are refused at compile, since source asset-to-FP rounding was not independently established. Both shipped stages author exact integer values.
No original gameplay execution, browser integration, deployment, human visual comparison or online test was performed. completePhysicsFidelity remains false.
